heading: NHS App-kaaga:
tagline: Si fudud u hel adeegyada daryeelkaaga caafimaad wakhti kasta
otherDownload: Siyaabo kale oo lagu soo dejisto NHS App
help: Ma u baahan tahay caawimo dheeraad ah?
helpText: La xiriir xarunta dhakhtarkaaga guud (GP) haddii aad caawimo uga baahan tahay adeegyada ay bixiso, ama booqo xarunta caawimada rasmiga ah ee NHS App.
official: Caawimada rasmiga ah ee NHS App
emergency: Haddii ay jirto xaalad degdeg ah oo nafta halis gelinaysa, wac 999. Haddii aad u baahan tahay caawimo caafimaad oo degdeg ah, isticmaal NHS 111.
video: Daawo fiidyowyada hagitaanka rasmiga ah ee NHS App
footer: Hagaha macluumaadka bukaanka · Waa in nuxurka dib loo eego ka hor daabacaadda
disclaimer: Kani waa hage macluumaad oo keliya, mana aha NHS App. Weligaa ha gelin faahfaahinta gelitaanka NHS boggan.

sections.title: Sida loo bilaabo
steps: Ka soo dejiso NHS App App Store ama Google Play.
Fur app-ka oo samee NHS login adigoo isticmaalaya cinwaanka iimaylkaaga, ama gal haddii aad hore u lahayd.
Raac tilmaamaha lagu xaqiijinayo aqoonsigaaga haddii lagaa codsado.
Markaad gasho, fur Profile oo ka raadi dejimaha gelitaanka si aad u hawlgeliso aqoonsiga faraha ama wejiga haddii qalabkaagu taageero.
sections.note: Waa inaad jirtaa 13 sano ama ka weyn oo aad ka diiwaangashan tahay xarun dhakhtar guud (GP) oo ku taal England si aad u isticmaasho adeegyada NHS App.

sections.title: La xiriir xarunta dhakhtarkaaga guud
steps: Fur NHS App oo ka raadi Appointments ama ikhtiyaarka lagula xiriirayo xarunta dhakhtarkaaga guud.
Dooro Contact your GP surgery haddii ikhtiyaarkaas la heli karo.
Buuxi foomka internetka oo dir.
Xaruntaadu waxay kuu sheegi doontaa sida iyo goorta ay kuugu jawaabi doonto.
sections.note: Helitaanka adeeggan wuxuu ku xiran yahay xarunta dhakhtarkaaga guud. Ha isticmaalin foomka internetka xaaladaha degdegga ah.

sections.title: Arag natiijooyinka baaritaannada
steps: Ka dooro Test results gudaha NHS App.
Akhri macluumaadka muhiimka ah oo dooro Continue haddii lagu weydiiyo.
Arag natiijooyinka baaritaannada ee kuu diyaar ah.
sections.note: Natiijooyinka oo dhan isla markiiba lama heli karo. La xiriir kooxdaada daryeelka caafimaadka haddii aad su'aalo ka qabto natiijo.

sections.title: Dalbo daawooyinka joogtada ah ee laguu qoro
steps: Dooro Prescriptions.
Dooro Request or view prescriptions.
Dooro daawooyinka joogtada ah ee aad u baahan tahay.
Hubi codsigaaga oo dir.
Isticmaal NHS App si aad ula socoto halka uu marayo codsigaagu haddii adeeggan la heli karo.
sections.note: Codso daawooyinkaaga joogtada ah waqti fiican ka hor inta aysan kaa dhammaan. Daawooyinka qaarkood lagama codsan karo app-ka.

sections.title: Ballamaha xarunta dhakhtarka guud
steps: Dooro Appointments.
Arag ballamahaaga dhakhtarka guud.
Ballan qabso, beddel ama jooji haddii xarunta dhakhtarkaaga guud ay bixiso ikhtiyaarradan.
sections.note: Ballamaha la heli karo iyo ikhtiyaarradu way ku kala duwan yihiin xarumaha.

sections.title: Gudbinnada iyo ballamaha isbitaalka
steps: Dooro Appointments.
Ka raadi Hospital referrals and appointments.
Arag macluumaadka la heli karo ee ku saabsan gudbinnada, liisaska sugitaanka ama ballamaha.
Haddii la taageero, raac tilmaamaha si aad u maamusho ballantaada.
sections.note: Waxa aad arki karto ama maamuli karto waxay ku xiran yihiin isbitaalka ama adeeg-bixiyaha.

sections.title: Farriimaha iyo ogeysiisyada
steps: Dooro Messages si aad u akhrido farriimaha ka yimaada xarunta dhakhtarkaaga guud, isbitaalka ama adeegyada kale ee NHS.
Si aad u maamusho digniinaha, fur Profile oo ka raadi Notifications.
Raac tilmaamaha qalabkaaga si aad u oggolaato ogeysiisyada NHS App.
sections.note: Ikhtiyaarrada ogeysiisyadu way ku kala duwanaan karaan qalabka.

sections.title: Maamul adeegyada qof kale
steps: Fur Profile.
Dooro Family and carer access haddii la heli karo.
Dooro qofka laguu oggolaaday inaad maamusho adeegyadiisa.
Isticmaal adeegyada qofkaas loo heli karo, dabadeedna ku noqo boggaaga gaarka ah markaad dhammayso.
sections.note: Waa inaad haysataa oggolaansho ku habboon si aad u gasho adeegyada NHS ee qof kale.
